title: fix(runtime): the dispatcher's observability Proxy wraps PUT and PATCH, so those routes carry X-Request-Id and report their 5xx
body:
Fixes #24025

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

`createDispatcherPlugin` wraps its `IHttpServer` in a `Proxy` that hands each route registration to `instrumentRouteHandler`. The trap named `get`, `post` and `delete` only, so every route the dispatcher mounts through `put` or `patch` was registered bare. Those routes answered with no `X-Request-Id` and left `req.requestId` unset. A 5xx on them never reached `observability.errorReporter`, and their `[5xx]` log line carried no method, route or request id.

The bare mounts on `origin/main` were:
- `PUT` and `PATCH /keys`.
- The `PUT` and `PATCH` mounts of the three `/notifications` paths.
- `PATCH /packages/:id`, `/enable` and `/disable`.
- `PUT /automation/:name`.
- The `PUT` and `PATCH /ai/*` wildcards.
- Service-emitted PATCH routes (`ai:routes` → `mountRouteOnServer`).

This restores a contract that is already published, in two places:
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx`: the id "is attached by the observability instrumentation wrapper", and a deployment that composes it "echoes a **valid inbound** `X-Request-Id` and otherwise mints" a `req_`-prefixed hex id.
- `content/docs/deployment/production-readiness.mdx`: "every route the dispatcher mounts now: … Echoes `X-Request-Id` (honored from caller, or freshly minted). Reports 5xx exceptions to Sentry (or your reporter) with the request id attached."

## The change

- **Producer:** `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`. The Proxy now wraps all five route verbs that `IHttpServer` declares (`get`, `post`, `put`, `delete`, `patch`). The list is typed with `satisfies ReadonlyArray of keyof IHttpServer`. `use`, `getRawApp` and `setFallbackHandler` still pass through unchanged.
- **`instrumentRouteHandler` is unchanged.** I read it before deciding: it treats the method only as a metric and reporter label, and nothing in it branches on the verb.
- **No second metrics emitter, measured.** On a transport that implements `afterResponse` (the shipped Hono adapter), the wrapper's counter and histogram are already gated off for every verb (`emitHttpRequestsTotal` / `emitHttpRequestDurationMs` = `!transportCountsRequests`). So PUT and PATCH stay at one sample per request; the real-socket row below pins that. On a transport without the seam, the wrapper now counts and times PUT and PATCH under their own method label, as it always did for GET, POST and DELETE.
- **Comment-only corrections in the same file.** The fix made three comments false:
  - The `/mcp/skill` method-set note gave the three-verb Proxy as a reason not to mount PUT/PATCH. No route is added there.
  - One sentence in the `/keys` block and one in the `/notifications` block said their PUT/PATCH mounts are not wrapped.
  - No mount helper or route body changed.
- **One past-tense retitle.** The #9650 §2 seam-A measurement in `http-metrics-inbound-coverage.hono.integration.test.ts` builds its own inline copy of the old three-verb Proxy. Its assertion is unchanged. Its title now reads in the past tense, with a note pointing at the new pin, so it no longer describes today's code.

## Pins

- **New `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-observability-every-verb.test.ts`.** It runs the real plugin over a fake transport, with tables over all five verbs. GET, POST and DELETE are the in-file positive control.
  - `/api/v1/keys`: a valid inbound id is echoed and lands on `req.requestId`, and one is minted when none is sent.
  - `/api/v1/ai/*`: a route-table handler that throws produces a 500. `errorReporter` receives that same error with `requestId`, `method` and `route`. The `[5xx]` line carries method, path and request id.
  - One service-emitted PATCH route through `ai:routes`, which reports its 5xx too.
  - On a transport without `afterResponse`: one counter sample and one duration sample per request, under the verb's own label.
- **`http-metrics-inbound-coverage.hono.integration.test.ts` §5.** A new case beside the existing GET `X-Request-Id` case. Every `/api/v1/keys` verb over a real Hono socket echoes and mints the header, and the transport still counts and times each request exactly once.

## Ablation (run once, then restored)

I committed the fix first. Then `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put the old arm back (`prop === 'get' || prop === 'post' || prop === 'delete'`), and I ran both pin files. Both import `./dispatcher-plugin.js` relatively, so they read source and need no rebuild.

- **Fixed tree:** `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 48 passed (48)`.
- **Old arm:** `Test Files 2 failed (2)`, `Tests 10 failed | 38 passed (48)`.
  - The 10 red rows are exactly the PUT and PATCH rows: 9 unit rows and the real-socket row (`PUT echoes the inbound id: expected null to be 'probe-put-24025'`).
  - All 15 GET, POST and DELETE rows stayed green.
- **Restore proven by the tool:** blob after restore `0136bea52b19` equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Verification (head `2cf6682f8`, after merging `origin/main` `cb8756b00`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2` (the package's `test` script, with workers capped): `Test Files 408 passed (408)`, `Tests 6276 passed | 19 skipped (6295)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime run typecheck`: exit 0. `check:test-typecheck` held 27 files / 190 errors / 68 pinned signatures, and the new file added no debt.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the three changed `.ts` files: exit 0, no output.
- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` named 62 commands. I ran each with its exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciles 62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
  - Three of them first stopped on a local prerequisite, not a finding, and are green on rerun:
    - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched on this shallow clone.
    - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed the workspace built (111 require entry points across 69 packages load).
    - `check:type-check-debt` never got a turn on the shared lock and was rerun wholly under it (nothing above its ledger).
  - The 5 roster gates whose rosters sit under a touched directory are also green: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity` and `check:route-ledger-census`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Observation, not filed (owner: none).** `RouteDefinition.method` in `dispatcher-plugin.ts` is typed GET, POST, PATCH or DELETE, and `mountRouteOnServer` has no `put` arm. A service that emitted a PUT route on `ai:routes` would therefore be skipped; only the boot line's mount count would show it. No producer of a PUT route on that hook is named, so nothing is reachable. This is unchanged here and stays outside this card.
- **The returned-envelope path is unchanged.** A route that answers a returned 5xx envelope instead of throwing still reaches the `[5xx]` log line but not `errorReporter`, on every verb alike. That is consistent with the published "5xx exceptions" / "Unhandled exceptions specifically still reach the `errorReporter`" wording, so it is not a finding.
- **File surface versus the claim.** Besides the Proxy arm, this diff touches comment lines in the `/mcp/skill`, `/keys` and `/notifications` blocks of the same file (H3, extended to the two later comments that said the same thing). It also retitles the one §2 measurement case. Mount helpers, route bodies, `plugin-hono-server` and `packages/rest` are untouched.
